scenario: A freshly cloned repository with NO agent config of any kind; a developer opens it in each tool with that tool's out-of-box settings.

auto_approval.note: No repo config => no hooks/trusted servers. NB: committed hooks DO run with no trust prompt under `claude -p`/SDK (see R1).
auto_approval.quote: Claude Code checks workspace trust before it runs any hook from a settings file.

command_execution.note: `default` permission mode when the repo sets nothing effective.
command_execution.quote: Prompts before most edits, shell commands, and network requests.

filesystem_read.note: Reads outside the working directory are not stated to be blocked by default.
filesystem_read.quote: By default, Claude has access to files in the directory where you launched it

filesystem_write.quote: Prompts before most edits, shell commands, and network requests.

network_egress.note: No network sandbox by default; egress follows shell/WebFetch consent.
network_egress.quote: If Bash is allowed, Claude can still use `curl`, `wget`, or other tools to reach any URL.

secret_reach.note: In-workspace secret files (.env, keys) fall within the default read scope.

auto_approval.note: Hooks are enabled by default but repo hooks are per-hash trust-gated; no silent auto-run.
auto_approval.quote: Non-managed hooks must be reviewed and trusted before they run.

dual.quote: it can't edit files or run commands without approval

auto_approval.note: MCP tool calls ask by default; shell auto-run still depends on user-global Run Mode (not repo). Launch-time consent for a project-declared server is not documented.
auto_approval.quote: Cursor asks for approval before using MCP tools by default.

command_execution.reason: Cursor's effective default depends on the user's global Run Mode selection (Cursor Settings), which is not a repo-side artifact.

filesystem_read.reason: Not determined by the repo; governed by user-global Run Mode / sandbox settings.

filesystem_write.reason: Not determined by the repo; governed by user-global Run Mode / sandbox settings.

network_egress.reason: Cursor documents no repo-side network-egress grammar.

secret_reach.reason: Read scope is user-global (Run Mode), not repo-determined.

auto_approval.note: Default `mcpServers.*.trust` is false; no config => no trusted servers. A committed `trust:true` server auto-runs with no confirmation (see R1).
auto_approval.quote: When `true`, bypasses all tool call confirmations for this server (default: `false`)

command_execution.quote: 'default' prompts for approval, 'auto_edit' auto-approves edit tools, and 'plan' is read-only mode.

filesystem_read.note: Folder Trust is OFF by default, so a repo's `.gemini/` config and `.env` ARE honored by default (the protective safe mode only applies once the feature is enabled).
filesystem_read.quote: Workspace settings are ignored: The CLI will not load the `.gemini/settings.json` file from the project.

filesystem_write.quote: 'default' prompts for approval, 'auto_edit' auto-approves edit tools, and 'plan' is read-only mode.

network_egress.reason: `tools.sandbox` default is not documented verbatim (only asserted `undefined` in a non-verbatim summary); without a confirmed sandbox default the egress default is undetermined. `tools.sandboxNetworkAccess` (default false) only applies when the sandbox is on.

secret_reach.note: That protection applies only in safe mode; Folder Trust is off by default, so `.env` is loaded/reachable by default.
